checks.title: Cleanup remains reachable after account state change
acceptance: Current presented session cookie cleanup and own revocation allowed even when account unavailable; no newly minted identity.

checks.title: Public recovery/status routes retain their own safeguards
acceptance: Public status safe; unsupported/unconfigured recovery and invalid callback fail safely without private data, native unauthorized changes or external delivery.

checks.title: Implicit methods preserve source-grounded behavior
acceptance: Unsupported protected HEAD404 empty/no authority header; get-session POST405 with current config; OPTIONS204; pathless set-password404. No private data/native writes.

checks.title: Outer auth.api own-account calls share current-account gate
acceptance: Active200 real current owned session; inactive401 CURRENT_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE; revoked200null or recognized401 CURRENT_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE; reject500/undefined/malformed results.
Denied responses no user/session/token/private canaries; native business/accounts/sessions/audits unchanged. Exported getSession only; pathless setPassword remains source/unit coverage.
